Property Features

ERF Size 961 m²

Blank Canvas for a dream build or Investment Opportunity

Size: 961 m² | Unserviced Plot

An excellent investment opportunity awaits in the sought-after Surrey Estate. This spacious 961 square meter vacant plot is ideally positioned in a neat, well-established neighborhood surrounded by quality-built homes.

The property is perfectly suited for the development of up to three dwellings, making it an attractive option for generating rental income. Draft building plans are available (not yet approved), offering a head start for investors or developers looking to maximize the site’s potential.

With its prime location and strong rental demand in the area, this land presents a rare chance to create a profitable multi-unit development in a thriving community.
